title: CutRight advisory cloud semantic evidence
description: Advisory-only output from an optional cloud provider (REV2 plan §15.6). Deliberately carries no time-position field of any kind — no start_ms/end_ms, no frame or sample index, no word/segment id — so it structurally cannot serve as cut-boundary or word-timing authority. A caller that wants to place this evidence on the timeline must derive timing independently from local, hash-bound signals (VAD, transcript words).
